held_out_window.relationship_to_prior_research: pre-ENGINE-23 universe; disjoint from ENGINE-26 forward window
held_out_window.limitation: backward-held-out historical evidence, not a live chronological forward

common.causal_pivots: 2-bar wings; pivot known only after right wing closes
common.same_bar_policy: close-entry outcomes begin on the next candle; simultaneous future-candle TP/SL is excluded from clean metrics
common.deduplication: first candidate per symbol/family, then 8 closed bars cooldown
common.portfolio_risk_model: chronological clean trades, fixed 1% equity risk per trade; simultaneous candidates remain separate research observations

SHORT_CONTINUATION_PRACTICAL_TARGET.context: confirmed LH/LL, EMA20 < EMA50, close breaks latest confirmed swing low
SHORT_CONTINUATION_PRACTICAL_TARGET.trigger: bearish close, body >=0.35 ATR, close in lower 35%, volume ratio >=1.0
SHORT_CONTINUATION_PRACTICAL_TARGET.target: nearest causal support when 1.5R..2R; otherwise fixed 2R only for strong momentum, else fixed 1.5R

SHORT_FAILED_REBOUND.context: LH/LL, EMA20 < EMA50, 1.25 ATR downswing followed by 2..6 bar rebound not exceeding prior confirmed high
SHORT_FAILED_REBOUND.trigger: bearish failure close below previous low near EMA20/rebound high; volume ratio >=0.9
SHORT_FAILED_REBOUND.target: closer of prior impulse low and fixed 1.25R, requiring at least 1R room

RANGE_BOUNDARY_REJECTION.context: 48-bar confirmed range, >=2 causal pivot touches each side, width 2..8 ATR, EMA spread <=0.6 ATR, ADX <=25
RANGE_BOUNDARY_REJECTION.trigger: boundary touch and rejection close back inside; volume ratio >=0.8

TRAP_REVERSAL.trigger: false break by >=0.05 ATR and close back inside with volume ratio >=1.0

MOMENTUM_BREAKDOWN_PULLBACK.context: EMA20 < EMA50 and a 1..3 bar-old support breakdown with body >=0.55 ATR, lower-third close, volume ratio >=1.2
MOMENTUM_BREAKDOWN_PULLBACK.trigger: short pullback stays within 0.75 ATR of broken support, then bearish continuation below previous low; volume ratio >=0.9
